confidence_notes: Brno-specific price indexes support meals, coffee and beer. The cocktail estimate comes from a very small current city sample; the wine glass is estimated from its price relationship to local draft beer. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates without current listing checks.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Brno-specific aggregated prices. No external accommodation comparable was used; lodging is estimated holistically for a mid-sized Central European university city.
